claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an LG front-loading washer-dryer with LG logo and “DirectDrive 6/3kg” text, but does not show any power-on test, spinning, drying, or error codes.
Witness report states LG logo visible on the control panel and “DirectDrive 6/3kg” text read from photo 0.

risks.risk: Non-working unit / major fault (won’t spin, won’t drain, or won’t heat to dry). Photos don’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of power-on and a full cycle: wash spin + dryer heat (or at least dryer heating indicator/temperature rise) with no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / for parts or repair.

risks.risk: Dryer heating element failure (common in washer-dryers) even if wash works.
risks.proof: Clip showing dryer running with heat (e.g., drum warming) and no error; ideally a temperature/heat indicator on the panel.

risks.risk: Drain/pump or hose/filter blockage causing water not to drain or leaving water in drum.
risks.proof: Video of the drain/spin stage with water level dropping to empty and no leaks around the base.

risks.risk: Door seal (rubber gasket) damage causing leaks or poor sealing.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rubber door seal plus a clip of water running during wash with no leakage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as seal may be compromised.

risks.risk: Drum interior rust/stains or damage affecting hygiene and performance.
risks.proof: Direct close-up shots of the drum interior and rubber seal area (inside drum) under light.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage around door/lower panel could indicate impact or poor mounting (may correlate with internal issues).
risks.proof: Photos of both sides and back panel, plus close-ups of the lower front panel and door hinge area.

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the display, any error codes, and starting a wash cycle.
Video of the unit completing a wash spin stage (drum spins, water drains) with no leaks.
Video of dryer operation (heat on) or a clear demonstration that drying works.
Close-up photos of the drum interior and the rubber door seal.
Photos of the back panel and sides, and any label/serial plate for exact model confirmation.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer-dryer, but there is no proof it works; the seller’s “doesn’t work/needs repair” is unverified by the report. Price it at the worst case (not working/for repair) while noting the brand claim conflict (Samsung vs LG) as contradicted.
